parsed.internal_thinking: I have one Knight card. The robber is currently on Hex 11 (Ore 3), which belongs to Claude. Claude is my primary antagonist and has a hidden development card. Jimmy just spent his resources to build a road and is currently low. My own resources are 1 Sheep and 2 Wheat. I need Brick and Wood to reach the 3:1 port at N51. Playing the Knight before rolling could allow me to steal a resource from Claude (who has Wheat and Wood) and potentially unblock myself if he moves it later, but since the robber is already on Claude's Ore 3 and I don't have any of my own production blocked right now (the robber is on Hex 11, none of my nodes 20 or 44 touch Hex 11), it's better to roll first. If I roll a 7, I can move it then. If I roll and get resources, I might have more leverage. There's no immediate threat to my position that requires a pre-roll Knight.
parsed.note_to_self: החלטתי לשמור את האביר לבינתיים כי השודד כבר חוסם את קלוד ב-3 אבן ולא חוסם אותי. מחכה לראות מה יצא בקוביות לפני שאני פועלת.
